name: riokulabs-site
description: Rioku Labs website (rioku.dev): Strapi 5 CMS (cms/) + Astro site (web/)

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd cms && npm install && cd ../web && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n cms,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:cms" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.check: cd cms && npm run check && cd ../web && npm test
